about: Where the titles of fixed-date observances differ from the headings of the 1962 Missale Romanum, as scripts/compare-missal-titles.mjs reads them from saved pages of its Proper of Saints (www.clerus.org/bibliaclerusonline/en/gmu.htm to gmz.htm and gm0.htm, saved 2026-11-10). The pages are not in this repository; set MISSAL_DIR to a folder with them to re-check.

st-bridget-of-sweden.differs: la adds widow; es adds widow
st-bridget-of-sweden.why: The saved page misreads the heading: it has 'S. Birgittae Vici.' for 'Vid.'. She is a widow.

noHeading.why: No heading was matched for these. Most are feasts of the 1st and 2nd class, printed in capitals under a page title without the line 'Die N mensis'; some are commemorations Missale Meum keeps as observances of their own (the days in the octave of Christmas, St. Peter on 25 January), and a few have a heading the saved page misreads ('S. Tirnothei'). Their titles were read by eye.
